Question: Asslam alekum slam ke bad mai aap sa jann chahta hu ki agar Bap ke samne bete ka intekal ho jay to kya bete ki aulad be dakhal ho jati hai kya shariyat mai aysa koi kanun agar aisa hai to na hak chote baccho ka kya hoga our uski bibi ka kya hoga ham log kaha jay ab to dada ka bhi intekal ho chuka hai hamare chacha our phoppo is bat ka galat fayda uthate hai plz give me ans. Answer ID: 7625 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1948/1725=B/1429) This is the Islamic ruling that if a son dies before his father, then children of the son (grandchildren) will not get any share in the property (of their grandfather) if he has other sons as well. After the demise of son, the father should have given some shares from his properties to the wife and children of the late son for their livelihood. If he did not do so, then it is his carelessness. The other brothers of the late should morally give some shares to their late brother's wife and children for their livings; by this they will get reward and even the soul of the father will be in peace. Also, according to the Holy Quran, something should be given to them morally. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
